name: Quran for Android
tagline: Read and listen to the Quran on your phone
description:
Quran for Android shows the mushaf as high-quality page images, so the Arabic looks the way it does in print. Tap a verse to hear it recited, read a translation in your own language, or open a tafsir commentary that explains it.

Translations, tafsir and recitations are downloaded inside the app, so once you have them you can read and listen with no connection. You can choose from a long list of reciters, bookmark verses, and jump straight to any sura or page.

The page images and audio files are large, so give the first downloads some time and a Wi-Fi connection.
